template.description: The template rendered once per record over record.* (the uses:/of: fields) and config.* (ADR-057); the result is the one field provides: declares. The runner loads {file:} before validation.

provides.description: The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033): exactly one field, the rendered text. Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:.

of.description: The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:.
